messages: A small bird pauses nearby. Mochi watches without hurrying it.
A bird tilts its head at the window. Mochi quietly tilts too.
A tiny mouse peeks in. Mochi gives it plenty of room.
Soft paws pass by soft paws. The little visitor continues on its way.
A butterfly drifts past. Mochi follows it with wide, patient eyes.
A small blue wing crosses the light, then disappears into the day.
A leaf turns slowly outside. Mochi lets it keep travelling.
One copper leaf taps the window, then the breeze carries it on.
Rain traces little paths down the window. Mochi watches one reach the bottom.
The rain is soft enough to listen to. You and Mochi stay a moment.
Snow gathers quietly beyond the glass. Mochi's nose almost touches it.
A few snowflakes turn in the air. Mochi watches each one choose a place.
A small flower has opened near the step. Mochi admires it where it grows.
A loose feather rests by the path. Mochi looks, then leaves it for the wind.
The box was empty. Now it is exactly full of Mochi.
Mochi has inspected the box and found no reason to leave it.
Mochi tucks every paw away and becomes a very quiet loaf.
For now, Mochi has chosen the shape of warm bread.
Mochi finds a short ribbon already loose on the floor and tucks it on the shelf.
A blue button has no coat to return to. Mochi carries it carefully home.
